What do you think about the Destiny Beta?

The game seems pretty cool. Lots of weapon options and character customization. It's cool seeing other people running around while you're doing missions, and the public event idea is neat.

My only gripe is that the loading times when in orbit are soooooo long. Oh well, first work problems I guess.

Edit: I would have liked to see some sort if stat or ability difference between the different races.

Much different than I expected. Having played the Halo series, I expected it to be more linear. I was pleasantly surprised to see open world sections, and the MMO aspects of the game have me hooked. I loved just zooming around Old Russia with friends, and the missions and story have me wanting more. The public events are great, and I hope we see a greater variety of them in the full game.

On the other hand, I feel like the competitive multiplayer is way too unbalanced. I suppose in a game about collecting new gear and constantly improving your character weapon balanced is expected to be a bit off. However, I felt like that even though I was level 8 and had what I thought was decent gear I still couldn't compete. The only time I felt like I did halfway decently was after hours of grinding to try and get better gear in the PvE sections of the game. After playing Halo for so many years, playing a Bungie-made shooter that isn't at least somewhat balanced is a bit odd. I hope they add in a mode where things like weapons and character stats are negated, and everyone is on a level playing field.
